# Komiuta â€” bus ticket booking for Kenya, Uganda and Tanzania.

> Komiuta is an East African bus booking platform. Travellers compare intercity
> bus fares, pick seats, and pay with M-PESA, card or mobile money. Tickets are
> delivered instantly by SMS and email.

Key facts:
- Fares are shown in KES and include all fees.
- Payment methods: M-PESA, Airtel Money, card (Flutterwave / Paystack).
- Seat selection, live seat availability, free cancellation on eligible tickets
  up to 2 hours before departure.
- Tickets are delivered by SMS and email; support: hello@komiuta.com, 0800 211 211.
